decisions.rationale: Intended Mega: Mega Gengar. reflections.summary: Lost because the team lacked speed control and offensive pressure to break through Krookodile + Hydrapple after Hydreigon fell early. Mudsdale was overwhelmed by repeated Knock Off and Giga Drain, and Farigiraf could not set Trick Room before being KOed. The four brought (Gholdengo, Hydreigon, Farigiraf, Mudsdale) had no answer for Gengar-Mega in the back, and the intended Mega (none) left a speed disadvantage.
reflections.adjustment: Bring Aerodactyl or Arcanine next game to provide Tailwind or Intimidate support, and consider leading with Farigiraf to set Trick Room immediately. Target Hydrapple with Gholdengo's Shadow Ball or a faster special attacker before it can heal. Avoid relying on Mudsdale as the sole win condition against a team with multiple special attackers.
